part.name: crossed tubular arm and central clamp assembly

part_functions.name: crossed-arm support
part_functions.function: Provides two long, intersecting structural members for supporting or locating external components around a central hub.

part_functions.name: central clamping and pivot interface
part_functions.function: Captures the two crossing members between opposed rounded-square clamp bodies and provides a concentric central mounting or pivot passage.

part_functions.name: end attachment interface
part_functions.function: The open axial passages at the arm ends allow insertion, fastening, coupling, or routing through the tubular members.

section_functions.name: diagonal load-carrying member
section_functions.function: Spans diagonally through the central assembly, transfers bending and axial loads, and supplies hollow end interfaces.

section_functions.name: central clearance and retention
section_functions.function: Locally shaped transitions and transverse cylindrical interfaces let the arm pass through and register with the central clamp.

feature_functions.name: structural span
feature_functions.function: The long rounded rectangular tube resists bending while minimizing material, and its axial bore forms open attachment interfaces at both ends.

feature_functions.function: Stepped, rolled, and blended local surfaces reduce the arm section near the hub to clear the clamp while avoiding abrupt stress concentrations.
